description: Defines classes for WebRTC command channels (client and server) that facilitate sending and receiving WebRTC commands over a shared file descriptor channel.

classes.name: WebrtcClientCommandChannel
classes.description: Handles sending WebRTC command requests and receiving responses over a shared file descriptor.

classes.name: WebrtcServerCommandChannel
classes.description: Handles receiving WebRTC command requests and sending responses over a shared file descriptor.

methods.name: WebrtcClientCommandChannel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client command channel with a shared file descriptor.

methods.name: SendCommand
methods.description: Sends a WebRTC command request and returns the response.

methods.name: WebrtcServerCommandChannel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server command channel with a shared file descriptor.
